recognize_zh: 照片呈現移植後皮膚硬化型慢性 GVHD 的多種表現：斑駁的色素沉著與脫失、腹部發亮緊繃的硬皮、前臂皮下凹凸不平的波紋狀（筋膜炎）、雙手無法合掌的「祈禱徵」，以及小腿足部硬化合併潰瘍。
features: Panel A: mottled hyper- and hypopigmented patches with lichen sclerosus-like texture on the upper arm
Panel B: dyspigmented, shiny, bound-down skin of both forearms and hands
Panel C: erythematous, taut, glossy indurated plaques over the abdomen
Panel D: rippled, cobblestone/'cellulite-like' surface of the forearm indicating deep fascial involvement
Panel E: positive prayer sign with inability to fully oppose the palms due to joint contracture
Panel F: sclerotic, hyperpigmented lower leg and foot with erosions, crusts and ulceration
describe_en: Clinical photographs show the spectrum of sclerotic-type chronic graft-versus-host disease of the skin. Superficial involvement appears as mottled dyspigmentation with lichen sclerosus-like changes (panels A–B) and taut, glossy erythematous sclerotic plaques on the abdomen (panel C). Deeper involvement is shown by a rippled, dimpled forearm contour consistent with fasciitis (panel D) and restricted joint mobility demonstrated by a positive prayer sign (panel E). Advanced disease produces sclerosis of the lower leg with erosions and ulceration (panel F). These are clinical, not histologic, images; findings are consistent with sclerotic chronic cutaneous GVHD, which meets NIH diagnostic criteria (sclerotic features, fasciitis, joint contracture).

ddx.vs: Systemic sclerosis typically begins acrally with Raynaud phenomenon, sclerodactyly and nailfold capillary changes and specific autoantibodies (Scl-70, anticentromere), without a history of allogeneic transplantation.
Morphea forms discrete indurated plaques with a lilac border in patients without transplant and lacks the widespread poikiloderma and fasciitis of GVHD.
Eosinophilic fasciitis produces a similar groove sign and peau d'orange but occurs after exertion with peripheral eosinophilia and spares the fingers and face, outside the transplant setting.
NSF follows gadolinium exposure in renal failure and involves extremities with brawny induration, sparing the face, without transplant history.
